description: This file contains test scripts for the 'tree' class within the TestLink project. It initializes the page, creates a 'tree' object, and exercises several of its methods such as getNodeByAttributes, get_available_node_types, get_node_hierarchy_info, get_subtree, get_subtree_list, get_path, and get_children, displaying their outputs for testing purposes.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class representing hierarchical node structures in TestLink, providing methods for node retrieval, hierarchy, and subtree operations.

methods.name: getNodeByAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a node from the tree based on specified attributes, such as 'type' and 'name'.

methods.name: get_available_node_types
methods.description: Returns a list of node types available in the tree.

methods.name: get_node_hierarchy_info
methods.description: Provides hierarchical information about a node given its ID.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Retrieves a subtree starting from a specified node ID, with options to exclude certain node types or branches.

methods.name: get_subtree_list
methods.description: Provides a list of nodes within a subtree starting from a given node ID.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Returns the path from a starting node to an optional target node, with different formats available.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Retrieves the child nodes of a specified node.
